notes.title: Dwarves & Dungeons —— Official Version Released!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Dwarves & Dungeons has ended its early access phase and is now officially launched, featuring all the content for the third character. The game is also participating in the Lunar New Year Sale with a 50% discount. Feel free to give it a try!

Latest Trailer Here:
[previewyoutube=BvMIfq0st5Y;full][/previewyoutube]

And welcome to our Discrod！
